timing_method: Observed solver time +60s/case for preprocessing/upload, six parallel workers, batch startup/queue overhead and GPU fitting. Different heights/moisture may change runtime; ETA is not a guarantee.
storage: Keep full raw evidence and training fields in the same cloud region; fetch only selected visualizations locally. Expected tens of GB, roughly40-60GB compressed raw plus50GB decoded fields. Retention beyond this campaign is ongoing storage cost.
safety: Reserve complete group/GPU allowance centrally before submission; no automatic retries or reservation recycling. Cloud deadlines and cleanup. Preserve periodic FDS restart and GPU optimizer checkpoints. Verify same-Linux resume before each long solve. Stop dispatch if cap or deadline would be exceeded.
pricing: Budget assumptions derived from prior experiment planning, not a live invoice or quoted SKU price.
